## Exam Prep Progress Dashboard

A 6-week view of study effort and quiz performance shows steady improvement, with the strongest gains in quiz score coming alongside higher Math and Science time.

## Quiz Score Trend and Study Time Mix

Quiz score trend:
- Week 1: 68
- Week 2: 72
- Week 3: 75
- Week 4: 78
- Week 5: 82
- Week 6: 85

Study time by subject:
- Math: 6, 7, 8, 7, 9, 8 hours
- History: 4, 3, 4, 5, 4, 6 hours
- Science: 5, 6, 6, 7, 8, 7 hours
- English: 3, 4, 4, 3, 4, 5 hours

Chart-ready data:
- Line chart title: Quiz Score by Week
- Line chart axes: Week on x-axis, QuizScore on y-axis
- Stacked bar chart title: Study Time by Subject
- Stacked bar axes: Week on x-axis, Hours on y-axis

Week | Math | History | Science | English | Quiz Score
1 | 6 | 4 | 5 | 3 | 68
2 | 7 | 3 | 6 | 4 | 72
3 | 8 | 4 | 6 | 4 | 75
4 | 7 | 5 | 7 | 3 | 78
5 | 9 | 4 | 8 | 4 | 82
6 | 8 | 6 | 7 | 5 | 85

## Strengths and Weak Areas

- **Strengths:** Math and Science are the strongest subjects overall, with the highest weekly hours and the clearest alignment to rising quiz scores.
- **Strong momentum:** Quiz performance improves every week, from **68 to 85**, showing consistent progress and effective study habits.
- **Needs attention:** History and English receive fewer hours than Math and Science, so they are the most likely weak spots if exam coverage needs to be more balanced.
